title: Closed site access and area segregation
summary: We operate a fully enclosed construction site with facial recognition access and physical zoning to prevent unauthorized entry and control hazard exposure.

content.overview: We implement complete physical closure of the construction site, enforcing identity-based entry via facial recognition terminals, and segregate work zones (construction, prefabrication, office, living) with physical barriers to minimize interaction between hazardous and non-hazardous areas.
content.details: Hazardous operation zones (high-altitude, confined spaces, hot work) are further protected with standalone electronic fences and infrared alarms. This layered access control reduces the risk of unauthorized personnel entering high-risk areas and aids in emergency mustering. We chose facial recognition over simpler badge systems for higher identity assurance and real-time attendance tracking.
content.examples: Facial recognition turnstiles at main gate. Electronic fence with infrared beam interruption alerts for unauthorized entry into a live hot work area.
content.references: Company site security and HSE plan.
content.caveats: System requires stable power and network; regular maintenance needed to avoid false alarms or lockouts. Physical segregation must be checked after storms or heavy vehicle movements.
